sections.changelog:
Added

  • CSV / YML (Yandex.Market) / XLSX import with streaming parsers
  • Auto-detection of delimiter, encoding (UTF-8/Windows-1251) and column mapping
  • Google Sheets URL auto-conversion to CSV export
  • ETag/Last-Modified change detection — skips download when source is unchanged
  • Multi-warehouse SKU merge with per-warehouse stock JSON
  • Field mapping UI with 11 dropdowns and auto-detect button
  • Category import with parent/child hierarchy
  • Featured image + gallery import with URL-change detection
  • WP-Cron scheduler with custom intervals + CLI runner + REST endpoint
  • Checkpoint/resume support for interrupted imports
  • Yandex.Market YML feed generation (general + per-warehouse)
  • Per-warehouse stock breakdown on product page and admin order view
  • JSONL file logger with rotation and paginated viewer
  • Full Russian (ru_RU) localization
  • Image import policy setting (new_only / always / never)
  • 5-tab admin UI: Main, Mapping, Log, Feeds, Help

Security

  • SSRF protection: IP allowlist, DNS rebinding detection, redirect blocking
  • XLSX ZIP-bomb guard (250 MB decompression limit)
  • Memory exhaustion guard during multi-warehouse merge
  • Credential leakage prevention in logs
  • Nonce verification + manage_options capability on all admin/REST endpoints
  • XXE-disabled XML parsing (LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_NOENT)
